name: Mitsubishi Chemical Group
h1: Becoming a Green Specialty Company, with one view of the work
lede: Mitsubishi Chemical Group is restructuring petrochemicals, considering a basic chemicals spin-off and reinventing operations with AI through its Accenture joint venture. Airtable gives transformation teams one connected view of every workstream.
why_h2: Restructuring, carve-outs and AI reinvention at once
why_p: Each of these programs generates cross-functional tasks, owners and milestones that need to be coordinated across the group.

signals.title: Green Specialty Company transformation
signals.body: CEO Manabu Chikumoto described the transformation into a Green Specialty Company, with accelerated petrochemicals restructuring and five specialty growth areas.
signals.angle: Transformation offices need one view of every workstream, owner and milestone.

signals.title: Basic chemicals spin-off under consideration
signals.body: The group began considering a spin-off of its basic chemicals business into a wholly owned subsidiary, with separation within FY2027.
signals.angle: Carve-outs generate hundreds of cross-functional tasks that belong in one connected tracker.

signals.title: Joint venture with Accenture
signals.body: Mitsubishi Chemical and Accenture established a joint venture to drive AI-enabled business reinvention and operational transformation.
signals.angle: AI operating programs need a connected system of record for the work itself.
signals.src: Mitsubishi Chemical Group news release, May 2026

signals.title: Green chemicals department reports to the President
signals.body: A new department reporting directly to the President was established to speed the commercialisation of green chemicals.
signals.angle: New departments can start on a connected layer instead of inheriting spreadsheets.
